mapper.select: SELECT md_person_dept.id, md_person_dept.dept_id, md_dept.dept_code, md_dept.dept_name, md_person_dept.person_id, p.person_code, p.real_name FROM md_person_dept LEFT JOIN md_person p ON p.id = md_person_dept.person_id LEFT JOIN md_dept ON md_dept.dept_code = md_person_dept.dept_id WHERE md_person_dept.dept_id = #{deptCode}
